description:
Activate Kozilek's Channeler by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Kozilek's Channeler.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Kozilek's Channeler.
Repeat.
